summary: The public SVG fixture owns versioned HTTP bootstrap DTOs/codecs and a narrow hand-written SignalR binding over the official client. Protocol HTTP/realtime sources compile against Thoth.Json.Net and Thoth.Json with shared named codec functions; this is not generated RPC or Fable.Remoting. Server RoomAuthority commits moves at ordered tick frontiers; reconnect requests a full authoritative snapshot, older ticks cannot rewind views and malformed/stale inputs refuse before gameplay. Frozen v1 legacy, v2 cooperative and v3 complete authored gameplay/content snapshots remain distinct. The source profile bounds authority to240arena cells with no occupied fallback, HTTP429 at exhausted admission and two-minute unbound/disconnected capability expiry. Static SVG player output alone is not the complete multiplayer runtime: its independently deployed ASP.NET authority is required. These source-defined bounds and pins are not measured host capacity, strong security isolation or a current installed/public receiver acceptance claim.
title: SVG fixture wire authority and finite resources
